verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair axis for an email API platform, such as batch sends to many recipients or bulk contact and suppression updates. The pack has no documented batch or bulk-operation capability. The only related claims are general statements about sending high volumes 'at scale', which describe throughput, not an operation that acts on many items at once. Community reports of high monthly send volume are likewise about throughput.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
